profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Python & Django | React | AWS | PostgreSQL | Backend & Full Stack Systems
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with nearly 4 years of experience building and maintaining production applications and services across healthcare, SaaS, and supporting platforms.

I work across the full stack using Python, Django, React, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, and Terraform, with experience designing REST APIs, modernizing legacy applications, building multi-tenant platforms, and integrating third-party systems.

I enjoy owning problems end-to-end — from understanding requirements and designing the solution through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. I’ve worked closely with engineers, designers, clinical teams, and business stakeholders to build systems that automate manual workflows, improve operations, and scale with growing product needs.
